headline: Crimson Tide Pods: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Crimson Tide Pods is projected #14 of 16 with a 538.60 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by DeVonta Smith, Alec Pierce, and Justin Herbert. The immediate priority is improving the RB slot without weakening that core. On the website's D-AVI ladder, the franchise ranks #7 of 16 with a 799.9 dynasty power score.

projected_power.method: Sum of the eight verified projected starters' C-AVI values from all 16 AVI-Core team files

dynasty_power.method: Power Rankings webpage D-AVI ladder: 65% canonical franchise D-AVI plus 35% starting-lineup C-AVI, with the championship-rank placement floor

latest_trade.summary: On July 24, Crimson Tide Pods traded with Corgi Loaf Baking Co. and acquired Gunnar Helm, Jakobi Meyers, 2027 Round 3 (Corgi Loaf Baking Co.), 2028 Round 2 (Corgi Loaf Baking Co.) while sending 2026 Round 1 (Crimson Tide Pods), 2026 Round 1 (All Hail King Jesus). Gunnar Helm is now on the current roster at 50.5 C-AVI and 70.7 D-AVI; Jakobi Meyers is now the current FLEX starter at 65.3 C-AVI and 79.1 D-AVI; The deal sent out 2 draft assets, reducing future flexibility; The deal added 2 draft assets.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the RB slot above Tyjae Spears's 51.0 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 57.8 C-AVI would directly attack the 6.80-point projected gap to Rapid Valley Annihilation.
Use draft capital as a targeted sweetener for a verified starting-lineup upgrade, not for additional bench depth.
